main_issue: Whether to keep the farewell lunch at the Korean barbecue the leaving colleague chose, or move to a different single place that all four can attend.

A-B.evidence: A first offers a compromise (no beef, T7) but then says 'one place it is. Any suggestions?' (T21); B keeps pushing for her choice (T22, T24).

A-C.evidence: A accepts the change ('We'll have to change it', T13) and asks for a place that works for C's 2:30 (T21), matching C's one-place view (T19).

A-D.evidence: A tries no-beef (T7), then concedes 'We'll have to change it' (T13); D wants another place (T11, T26).

B-C.evidence: B insists on her pick (T22, T24); C counters 'it's not a farewell if D can't come' (T23) and 'even if D can't be there?' (T25).

B-D.evidence: B's split plan (T16) and 'do what she wants' (T24) clash with D's 'stick to one place' (T20) and 'find somewhere else' (T26).

C-D.evidence: C: 'maybe look for another place' (T10); D agrees (T11, T20: 'I agree with Agent C'); D's T26 matches C's one-place position.
